method: Literal closed source fill contours from the original July2005KSH PDF page9, including all actual native subpaths and touching micro-triangles. Original decimal PDF vertices are evaluated exactly, then mapped by a three-road-junction EOV similarity and vertexwise EPSG23700→4326. No polygon repair, dropped component, smoothing, buffer, clipping, snapping, missing-edge cap, frame closure or current-name-point fit. Placement remains estimated; one two-control alternative is retained separately. Hódtó is invalid in source and already represented, so it is quarantined rather than repaired or counted again.
license: KSH2005 attribution required; separate data-transfer permission not established. ODbL-1.0 actual OSM controls/name evidence.
uncertainties: Geographic placement is estimated from three interpreted source-boundary road junctions, not surveyed source controls. C2 has historical/current street-name ambiguity. Main fit RMS15.03m is not an accuracy bound; an ambiguous held-out junction differs55.76–74.73m. The control triangle covers only small portions ofBelváros/Tabán; other candidate footprints are extrapolated. Source cartographic generalization, road-centre convention,2005/current change and unknown survey/CRS remain material. Literal current-street-name line checks diverge up to1014m where simplified historical descriptions do not match the whole mapped border under current names; no aliases or source corrections are inferred. Independent source Susán/Újváros rail135 check differs by up to84.21m. These diagnostics do not establish absolute accuracy or whole current extents. Four detached village depictions are schematic/compressed and are retained only in native source coordinates.
Nine historical identities do not establish present complete extents; KSH reuse/data-transfer conditions are not treated as an open licence.
rightsStatus: KSH2005 source-attribution and data-transfer-permission conditions; unrestricted permission unestablished.
